input.brief: Веб-студия для малого и среднего бизнеса: сайты, лендинги, интернет-магазины без шаблонов, с честными сроками и поддержкой после сдачи

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Giant cropped shape
hero.blueprint: A plain ground with one flat shape at enormous scale. The shape is the simplest geometry found in the subject (a circle, a ring segment, a chamfered block, an arch), drawn in CSS or as a single inline SVG path and filled with the accent colour. It is about 120vh across and enters from the right, centred near 78% of the width and 55% of the height, so the top, right and bottom edges of the viewport crop it and its left boundary reaches column 7. If the subject has a true pair (two accounts, two modes), a second shape in a second flat colour overlaps the first by a quarter with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. The headline sits on the bare ground on columns 1–6, vertically centred, flush left at 8% from the left edge: two lines at clamp(64px, 6.4vw, 100px), heavy weight, tracking -0.03em. Beneath it comes one supporting sentence at 19px, then the single action as a solid button cut to the same shape. A bold wordmark sits top-left at 32px; up to three text links sit top-right in the ground colour.
hero.mobile: The shape moves to the bottom: 130vw across, centred horizontally, its top at 56svh, cropped by the left, right and bottom edges. The headline sits above it at 11.5vw on two lines at a 16px margin, starting 15% down, with the sentence at 16px and the motif-shaped button beneath. Wordmark top-left; the links collapse to one word top-right.
hero.headline: Two lines of two or three words each, up to about 12 characters per line at 6.4vw.

type.note: An American gothic for headings over a sober transitional serif for reading, the pairing of a newspaper front page. Suits essays, annual reports, archives and finance pages that have real paragraphs.

palette.name: Card pastels
palette.note: Neutral paper ground and black type, with each card or tile given its own flat pastel (periwinkle, lime, amber or cyan), never two alike side by side. Magenta is reserved for the logo, the email address and text links.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Staircase statement
sections.blueprint: On a flat dark or saturated field one sentence of 12–18 words is broken into five short lines at clamp(36px, 4.4vw, 64px), bold, leading 1.02, marked up as one paragraph (a statement, so it may run past two lines at this size). Each line starts further right than the one above: indents of 0, 6, 12, 18 and 24vw from a 4vw left margin, set with `padding-left` per line, so the block descends like stairs and ends near the 75% mark. Each line takes its own flat colour from the palette, or lines alternate between two inks. The block is vertically centred in a section 100svh tall. The right quarter (columns 10–12) holds two stacked photographs, each 3:2 and 20vw wide with a 16px gap, top-aligned with the first line. No heading; a two-line note at 15px sits at the bottom-left margin, on the first line's left edge. On a page without images, leave the right quarter empty.
sections.mobile: Five lines at 9vw (35px on a 390px screen) with indents of 0, 5, 10, 15 and 20vw, so the stair still reads on a 390px screen. The two photographs follow below as one row of two equal 3:2 frames. The note sits last, left-aligned.

sections.name: Pinned heading, passing rows
sections.blueprint: One flat saturated field, full-bleed, as tall as its content. Columns 1–5: the heading, two or three words, at clamp(56px, 6.6vw, 104px) in the heaviest weight, position: sticky; top: 32px, so it holds while the right side travels. Columns 7–12: four to six capability blocks stacked with 120px between them. Each block is a title at 28px bold, then a two-part row: a portrait photograph at 3:4, 180–220px wide with square corners, and beside it, top-aligned, a plain list of four to six short lines at 18px with 14px between lines. Photographs alternate between the left and the right of their list, so the column does not read as a ladder. One ink colour, chosen for contrast on the field. The heading releases when the bottom of the last block reaches it.
sections.mobile: The heading becomes a sticky bar at the top of the section: one line at 9vw on the field colour with 12px padding, holding while blocks pass under it. Each block stacks its title, a full-width 4:3 photograph, then the list at 17px. 72px between blocks.

sections.name: Prices like a menu
sections.blueprint: Prices set the way a good menu sets them. A heading of two to three words at 32–40px sits in columns 1–3. Columns 5–12 hold the list in two text columns with a 64px gap. Items are grouped under plain group names at 24px in medium weight with 48px above each group. Each item is a row: the name at 19px on the left, the price at the same size on the right on the same baseline, with tabular figures and the currency sign shown only once per group; beneath the name, one line of description at 16px in the softer ink, no wider than 36ch. Rows are 22px apart. Name and price are joined only by empty space (flex with `justify-content: space-between`), with no dot leaders and no lines. One small photograph (4:5, three columns wide) may sit under the heading in the left zone.
sections.mobile: One column. The heading at 28px, then the photograph at 60% width if used. Each item keeps name left and price right on one line at 17px, with its description beneath in the softer ink. Group names at 20px with 40px above.

sections.name: Stacked folders with tabs
sections.blueprint: Projects are filed as folders: four to six full-width flat colour bands stacked so that each shows a 64px strip above the next, built with `position: sticky` and increasing `top` offsets (0, 64, 128px) so the bands pile up as the page scrolls. From the top-left edge of each band one or two tabs rise: filled shapes 44px tall and 200–320px wide with shouldered corners cut by `clip-path: polygon()` or an inline SVG path, side by side with 6px gaps, each in a flat colour that contrasts with its band. The project name sits inside the tab at 26–28px; the category sits right-aligned in the band's visible strip at 15px. An open band is 80svh: a 16:10 photograph in columns 1–7 and, top-aligned in columns 9–12, a 60-word description with a link. A two-word heading at 32px precedes the stack.
sections.mobile: Bands do not stick; they stack in normal flow, each led by one tab 40px tall with the name at 20px and the category beside it. Inside a band the photograph is full width at 4:3 with the description beneath at 16px and 20px padding.

sections.name: Two columns, highlighted words
sections.blueprint: The story is set as text far larger than anything else on the page: 110–160 words at clamp(22px, 2.1vw, 32px), tight leading 1.18, in the soft ink, flowing through two columns that fill the full width between 24px margins (`columns: 2; column-gap: 32px`, justified, with hyphenation on). No heading. The name at the start is in full ink. Six or seven single words or short phrases carry a flat highlighter background in three or four palette colours, built with an inline `background-color`, `box-decoration-break: clone` and 0.1em of horizontal padding; they mark the facts a scanning reader wants (a place, a year, a client, a skill). The final short sentence is highlighted entire in the strongest colour and is the link to contact. Padding 120px top and bottom. No image and no portrait.
sections.mobile: One column at 20px, left-aligned and unjustified, leading 1.25, with 18px margins. Keep four or five highlights so no line carries two. The final highlighted sentence sits on its own line with 24px above it and works as a full-width tap target.

sections.name: Accordion of tinted panels
sections.blueprint: A two-column introduction, then one horizontal accordion. Introduction: the heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), in columns 1–5; one paragraph at 18px in columns 7–11. 64px below, a flex row across columns 1–12, 520px tall, of four to six panels with no gaps. The open stage is a panel taking about 58% of the width; the rest are vertical slivers sharing what remains. Order is carried by colour: the first stage is the darkest tone of one hue and each later stage is a lighter flat tint of it, so the row reads dark to light from left to right. A sliver shows only its stage name, rotated 90 degrees and reading upward, at 20px bold, anchored to its bottom-left. The open panel shows the name at 40px top-left, a 36ch paragraph at 18px bottom-left and, optionally, one photograph in its right half. Clicking a sliver opens it (flex-basis transition, 450ms).
sections.mobile: The accordion turns vertical: stages stack at full width as bars 64px tall in the same dark-to-light order, names set horizontally at 18px. The open stage expands to its content height with the paragraph at 17px. The first stage is open by default.

sections.name: A band per question
sections.blueprint: Each question owns a full-bleed band, and the bands alternate between two flat tones (ground and one step away, or two palette colours with their assigned inks) and butt together with no gap. Inside every band the same grid applies: the question in columns 1–5 at 28–32px bold, top-aligned with 56px of padding above; the answer in columns 7–12 at 18px with leading 1.5, the same padding, and 56px below. Bands are as tall as their content, so their heights differ, which gives the stack its rhythm. Four to seven bands. The heading is the first band: two to four words at about 7vw on the accent colour, flush left, taller than the rest at about 40svh with the words anchored to its bottom-left. All answers are visible; there are no toggles.
sections.mobile: Bands stay full-bleed and alternate. Inside each, the question at 22px then the answer at 17px, with 32px padding top and bottom and 20px at the sides. The heading band is 30svh tall with its words at 13vw at the bottom-left.

sections.name: Photo strip, three-cell bar
sections.blueprint: A saturated flat field about 80svh tall. Across the top, 48px from the section edge, a strip of small photographs runs off both sides: all 150px tall at differing widths (3:4, 1:1, 3:2 in turn), 8px gaps, ten or more, drifting slowly as a marquee. A heading of two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px) sits 72px below the strip at the left margin. 40px below the heading, the newsletter or booking form is one bar spanning the content width, 96px tall, divided into three equal cells with 8px gaps. Each cell is a filled block in a tone one step from the field with one radius: the first two are inputs (name, email) with placeholder text centred at 18px, the third is the submit action in the inverse colours with its word centred. Focus changes a cell's fill to the lightest tone. Small print at 13px sits under the first and third cells.
sections.mobile: The strip is 110px tall and scrolls by touch. The heading follows at 9vw. The three cells stack as full-width filled blocks 60px tall with 8px gaps, the submit block last. Small print sits beneath the stack, left-aligned.

references.name: Paul Kalkbrenner
references.idea: Swiss poster typography for a techno artist: the name as one black line with a photo set inside it like a glyph, then every chapter gets its own flat colour and visible grid.
references.hero: Pure white viewport. The artist's name sits on one line at exact vertical centre in bold black neo-grotesk, about 10.4vw, spanning roughly 78% of the width with equal side margins. The space between first and last name is replaced by a small landscape black-and-white photo, x-height tall and resting on the baseline. Top-left is a tiny circular monogram; eight nav links in 13px bold are spread at even intervals across the right half of the top edge. Bottom edge: equaliser bars with a grey label over a track title at left, a three-line bold blurb starting just left of centre, a sound toggle hard right. About 85% is empty.
references.type: ABC Diatype Plus Variable only: bold at -0.05em tracking for display and 13.5px bold for everything functional. Display runs from 150px in the hero to about 44vw elsewhere per the digest. Tiny uppercase labels inside boxed cells; no second face, no italics.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #c5c5c5 #a7ff9c #ff6831 — Black on white to start, then whole sections flood with flat mid-grey, acid mint and orange. Photos inside coloured sections are tinted to the section hue or kept black-and-white.
references.imagery: Portraits and live shots of the artist: full-bleed colour images between sections, a grainy monochrome portrait marked up as a vinyl disc, a green duotone car portrait, and a strip of small mixed-ratio thumbnails. Square corners throughout.
references.layout: Outer margins of only 4-8px; content hangs on a visible column grid with hairlines and boxed cells. Sections alternate between full-bleed photographs and flat colour fields, each arranged differently, so the rhythm is one poster after another.

sections.description: Two words stacked in bold grotesk at roughly 8vw, each preceded by a solid black circle about the height of the lowercase, the second line indented further right than the first. Thin horizontal and vertical hairlines cross the white field at baselines and column edges like a construction grid. Directly beneath is a single row of streaming-service logos spaced evenly edge to edge, then a full-bleed photograph.

Flat mid-grey field split in two. Left half: a square grainy monochrome portrait with a large thin circle drawn on it and a small grey dot at the centre, so the photo reads as a record. Right half: a row of three year tabs and a small link above a hairline, the album title in small bold caps, a short description lower down, and along the bottom two wide outlined cells side by side acting as buttons.

Acid-mint field introducing the tour list. A large photograph, recoloured as a green-and-black duotone, occupies only the top-right quadrant; the left half is left empty. Along the bottom a table header with three tiny uppercase column labels sits on a hairline spanning the full width, where the list of dates begins.

Orange field. A horizontally scrolling strip of small photographs of differing widths runs across the top, cropped by both edges. Below it one outlined rectangle spans the width, divided into three equal cells: two inputs and a submit action, each identified only by tiny centred uppercase text. Small-print lines sit under the left and right cells.

steal: Replace the space between the two words of a giant name with a small photo cropped to x-height.
Flood each chapter with one flat colour and tint its photograph to match as a duotone.
Build forms and button pairs as adjoining outlined cells with tiny uppercase labels instead of filled buttons.
references.media: The hero is almost pure type: the only picture is a 113x75 chip set inside the name, under 1% of the fold, that changes photo every 1-1.5s. Later, full-bleed bands with scrubbed parallax between sections, a square cover in one half beside an info column, a green duotone portrait docked right, a full-bleed photograph that exits through a pixel-block mask, a receding stack of square photos, and an auto marquee of small thumbnails; one YouTube embed, no native video, square corners and an 8s grain overlay.
references.motion: There is no preloader, only the name chip cycling and the equaliser bars bouncing, and Lenis and Barba run 12 ScrollTriggers with no pins: media wrappers parallax by yPercent, a ruled statement drifts sideways, full-bleed photo sections scrub at 0.3 to drive the pixel-block dissolve, and year digits roll like an odometer. Link characters roll over 0.5s with a per-character delay on the house curve cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1) (.7s and .35s tokens).

references.name: Warm & Fuzzy
references.idea: A showreel-first studio site in which every section takes one flat, loud colour (blue, black, yellow) under heavy grotesk type and a chunky custom wordmark.
references.hero: The showreel plays full-bleed with a visible film-grain overlay and no scrim. A chunky hand-cut wordmark sits top left, 16px from the edges; the same top line continues with a one-sentence status link, a tiny thumbnail beside the latest project's name, and three caps links at the far right, all white over the footage. A small green caps play label floats at dead centre. The tagline is anchored bottom left, 16px from both edges, in white grotesk caps at 47px (3.3vw) on one line spanning 56% of the width. A tiny square pause control sits bottom right.
references.type: SuisseIntl throughout, rendering heavy, tracked -0.027em: a 47px caps tagline, a caps section title at 9.4vw, statement paragraphs around 5vw with tight leading, and 10 to 11px caps captions. The logo is custom chunky lettering with wobbly cut-paper counters.
references.colour: #000000 #190bb6 #f7dd47 #ffffff #e9479f #1fc27a — Each section is a flat field: ultramarine blue, black, yellow, then blue again. White type on blue and black, black on yellow; a green play label is the only small accent.
references.imagery: Commercial stills and video (candy-coloured CG worlds, product renders, live-action frames) in square-cornered thumbnails of mixed aspect ratios, with a grain layer over the whole page and floating glossy 3D sticker objects.
references.layout: Tight 16px outer margins and edge-to-edge type. Sections are told apart by background colour rather than spacing: a blue statement set in the right two-thirds, a black packed work wall, a yellow full-width paragraph, a blue footer.

sections.description: On black, a tiny caps motto sits top left, then a caps section title at about 9vw flush left with a small underlined link at the far right on its baseline. Beneath, thumbnails pack into an uneven wall: widths vary from one-sixth to one-half of the page, heights differ, gaps are about 8px and rows do not align. Under each image a 10px caps line gives the project name left and the year in grey right.

A yellow field filled edge to edge by one paragraph in black heavy grotesk at roughly 5vw with very tight leading, left-aligned at the 16px margin. Several lines contain deliberate word-sized gaps, as if the text flowed around something, and a small tilted image chip floats over the first lines, covering parts of words.

A full-screen blue field. A top row of tiny caps, email left and three links right, sits above a hairline. A glossy 3D sticker object hangs near the top centre. The chunky wordmark runs the full page width at the bottom in white, about a fifth of the viewport tall, above a bar of tiny caps links divided by vertical hairlines.

steal: Give every section one flat saturated background and change it at each section break, keeping type strictly black or white.
Pack work thumbnails at mixed widths and heights with 8px gaps and a two-part micro caption (name left, year right) under each.
End with the wordmark at full page width on a colour field, with all utility links reduced to a tiny caps bar split by vertical hairlines.
references.media: A 6s muted showreel covers the whole first screen with the nav and title on it and no scrim. Below: an asymmetric top-aligned mosaic of three tile widths (5, 7 and 12 of 24 columns) reshuffled each row with captions under, small inline thumbnails between words of a large paragraph, clips cut into geometric clip-path shapes, a full-bleed photo band with a marquee across its lower edge, and a glossy 3D cube drifting over text and the footer, all at 0px radius under a grain layer that steps every second.
references.motion: A brief ultramarine preloader with a tilted card, then the header and title slide and scale in over 0.5s after a 0.75s delay while the reel carries the motion. Lenis with CSS scroll-driven animations reveals blocks on the scroll timeline, parallaxes figures by 5 to 25svh, translates stacked assets in over 0.75s with a per-item delay and slides a giant sentence left with the scroll, all on one house ease, cubic-bezier(.26,1,.48,1), at 0.5s, with 29 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Pensatori Irrazionali
references.idea: The client roster becomes the hero object, a 3D sheaf of logo-printed fabric ribbons, and classical Italian ornament (copperplate script, engravings, tricolour) is collided with plain Helvetica.
references.archetype: other: offset 3d object with bottom-left statement
references.hero: Flat pale-grey field (#f5f5f5). A 3D-rendered bundle of woven fabric ribbons, each a different saturated colour and printed with a client logo, streams diagonally from beyond the top-right corner down to about centre-left, covering roughly the right two-thirds and bleeding off the top and right edges. Top-left: a small engraved lion crest with serif wordmark and a green-white-red bar. Top-right: two dark square icon buttons with chamfered corners. Bottom-left, in the lowest fifth: a tiny '+ (Atelier)' label above a three-line grey intro paragraph at about 36px, half the viewport wide. No headline and no call to action; the left third is empty.
references.type: Helvetica Now at regular weight does nearly everything, tracking -0.025em, sentence case, from 14px body to 60px menu links. Section titles pair it with huge hairline copperplate script words, and the footer wordmark is a heavy high-contrast serif at about 18vw.
references.colour: #f5f5f5 #434343 #292828 #e9e9e9 #e3342a #2bd92b — One pale grey ground throughout with charcoal rather than black text. Saturated colour is confined to the ribbon render and project images, plus a green and red flag underline and one neon-green dot.
references.imagery: Hero 3D render of logo-printed textile ribbons; black engraved illustrations (angel, Pegasus, lion) cut out and placed inside headings; dark-grey map silhouettes; square-cornered project stills in a horizontal row.
references.layout: Narrow 48px side margins with content hung on a loose two-column split at 50%. Sections alternate between oversized title bands that bleed off both edges and small hairline-ruled tabular lists, with generous blank grey between blocks.

sections.description: A title band runs edge to edge as one line: a hairline copperplate script word about 250px tall cropped by the left edge, a tiny superscript '(01)', a black engraving of an angel dropped in like an inline glyph, then a grotesk phrase at 90px running off the right edge. Beneath, two columns of client rows: name at about 40px, a tiny grey category label, the client's logo mark, a small arrow, each row closed by a hairline.

A grid of five columns by two rows of equal cells with faint 1px borders, each holding one small monochrome client logo, centred. Directly below, a wide empty band works as a map: a dark-grey country silhouette crops in at each side edge, with a two-line place name at 32px bottom-left and another bottom-right, each with tiny coordinates in parentheses underneath.

The same script-plus-engraving title band, now with a Pegasus and '(02)'. Below, a two-column table headed by tiny 'Number' and 'Service' labels over a hairline: the left column shows a giant hairline script numeral about 200px tall; the right holds a small '+ (Branding)' label, a service name with a neon-green dot, and ruled rows pairing a term at left with a grey descriptor right-aligned.

The first word of the name in a heavy high-contrast serif spans the full width and crops at the right edge (about 18vw), with a green underline under its left half and red under its right. Behind and below, the second word in giant pale-grey gradient script overlaps the serif letters. Under that, small columns: menu links at 18px, contact details at 11px, legal links at right.

steal: Turn the client-logo list into one physical object (logos printed on a rendered bundle of ribbons) so proof becomes the hero image instead of a logo strip.
Build section titles as one edge-to-edge line mixing a hairline script word, an inline engraved illustration and a plain grotesk phrase at similar height.
Keep the page on one pale grey with charcoal text and let colour enter only through imagery and a single flag-coloured underline on the footer wordmark.
references.media: A 3D cluster of logo-printed fabric ribbons covers about 60% of the first screen, bleeding off the top and right with the statement docked bottom-left. Below: engravings inserted between the words of a title marquee, hidden 16:9 previews behind a client index, three-up 16:9 tile rows overflowing the right edge as carousels, a single centred 16:9 video with wide ground either side, a staggered two-row collage bleeding off both edges, and map silhouettes cropped at the page edges; 39 images and 9 muted 16:9 videos, never under text.
references.motion: About 3-4s of intro after a 13.3s load: an inset crest card where a 2.25s fill keyframe runs, a white flash, the ribbons, then the copy de-blurring. Lenis with no pins: titles run as endless marquees, media rows are carousels, and content fades back in over 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) after each scroll step; coordinates roll digit by digit over 900ms on a spring-shaped linear() curve (157 WAAPI calls), and the manifesto letters roll up from doubled glyphs.
